escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat an internally valid readiness package inherited from another delivery as current because its files already exist.

literal_case.procedure: Classify inherited delivery artifacts against the resolved current target before reuse and again before terminal publication.
literal_case.observed: The current-target package was rebuilt for the material candidate; foreign-target lineage remains historical and is not used as current evidence.

prevention_change.evidence: Current target is resolved before package reuse and before terminal publication.

detection_change.evidence: Current exact-head evidence records target binding and the attack matrix executes foreign-package rejection.

escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Keep a readiness certificate bound to an ancestor after a material code, test, configuration or documentation write and rely on green CI instead of refreezing.

literal_case.procedure: Compare the certified material identity with the current candidate parent and changed paths, preserve the independent auditor recovery floor, then rebuild exact-head evidence before publishing a new result-only child.
literal_case.observed: The stale ancestor certificate was rejected, post-write-refreeze was selected, and evidence was regenerated for the current material candidate before terminal publication.

prevention_change.evidence: Any repository write after freeze invalidates the freeze and requires a new material-head evidence cycle; auditor recovery scope is a floor.

detection_change.skill_or_gate: recovery classifier plus terminal handoff parent/allowlist validation
detection_change.evidence: Classifier, exact-head evidence, and result-only parent/allowlist controls are all bound to the current material candidate.

trigger_terms: certificate material head differs from candidate

escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Rebuild a result-only handoff from only the newest active controls and silently omit retired controls or source-audit entries that exist in the material parent or previous handoff.

literal_case.procedure: Compare the replacement inherited-controls ledger with the material parent and the rejected handoff before publication.
literal_case.observed: The previously lost retired control is restored explicitly while all active controls and source-audit records remain cumulative.

prevention_change.evidence: Replacement handoffs are assembled from the cumulative union of material-parent lineage and prior handoff lineage instead of only the newest active controls.

detection_change.evidence: A focused lineage comparison now requires preservation of retired controls, active controls, and source-audit entries before result-only publication.
